items.question: Under the UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree Law No. 33 of 2021), how many days' prior written notice must an employer give to terminate an employee during the probation period?
items.fact: Employer must give 14 days' written notice during probation

items.question: What is the minimum monthly salary under a national student employment contract in the UAE private sector?
items.fact: National student contract salary at least AED 4000 monthly
